facts: Wind was 20-22 knots with one meter waves.
Finn boats, GER 37 and GER 334were both sailing downwind on port tack towards the leeward mark.
The boats were overlapped whenthey entered the zone. GER 37 was the inside boat. GER 334 was outside and two boat lengths to leeward of her.
5 meters after rounding the mark, while GER 37 was pulling in her sheets, there was contact between GER 37’sstarboard quarter and port side of GER 334.
There was a 10 cm scuff on theport side of GER 334. No boat took a penalty.
conclusions: GER 37 to windward, failed tokeep clear of GER 334 to leeward, and broke RRS 11.
GER 37 did not avoid contactwith GER 334 even though it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).
GER 334 did not avoid contact to GER 37 even though it was reasonably possible, and the contact caused damage, therefore GER 334 broke RRS 14(a).
decision: GER 37 and GER 334 are DSQ in Race 1
